name: DC Open WTA 2026: Results, Draw, Schedule, Entry List
snippet: The DC Open is due to take place on the WTA side between July 27 - August 2, 2026. It will be the 14th edition on the WTA side. It is a WTA 500 tournament and will take place at the William H.G. FitzGerald Tennis Center in Washington, DC from July 27 to August 2, 2026.
